language.title: Display language
language.description: UI language for the Spring panel. Use auto to follow OpenIDEA's UI language.

defaultProfile.title: Default active Spring profile
defaultProfile.description: Default Spring profile name used when evaluating effective configuration (leave empty for default).

inlayHintsEnabled.title: Enable Spring inlay hints
inlayHintsEnabled.description: Master switch for inline Spring annotations, bean wiring, endpoint, and cron hints.

showValueInlayHints.title: Show @Value resolved hints
showValueInlayHints.description: Display resolved effective configuration values inline next to @Value expressions.

showBeanInlayHints.title: Show Bean wiring hints
showBeanInlayHints.description: Display target Bean implementations inline next to injection fields and parameters.

showEndpointInlayHints.title: Show full route inlay hints
showEndpointInlayHints.description: Display full resolved HTTP paths (including class prefix and context-path) on endpoint methods.

showCronInlayHints.title: Show @Scheduled cron hints
showCronInlayHints.description: Display human-readable schedule descriptions next to 6-field Spring cron expressions.

diagnosticsEnabled.title: Enable Spring inspections
diagnosticsEnabled.description: Report live Spring Core, Boot Config, Web, Data JPA, SpEL, and Cron diagnostics while editing.

warnFieldInjection.title: Warn on @Autowired field injection
warnFieldInjection.description: Highlight field injection with a quick fix to convert to constructor injection.

warnUnknownProperties.title: Warn on unknown Spring Boot properties
warnUnknownProperties.description: Report unrecognized keys in application.yml/.properties outside @ConfigurationProperties or metadata.

consoleHighlighting.title: Highlight Spring Boot run console
consoleHighlighting.description: Apply ANSI-free Spring Boot log level, Hikari, Tomcat, Hibernate, and startup highlights in Run & Debug consoles.

actuatorUrls.title: Actuator endpoints
actuatorUrls.description: Comma-separated Spring Boot Actuator base URLs to poll when inspecting runtime applications.

agentPortRange.title: Runtime agent probe port range
agentPortRange.description: Loopback TCP port range scanned for the optional OpenIDEA Spring runtime agent.
